sentences.text: Kuldeep vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 13 September, 2024

Author: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi
Bench: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:150300-Db
Court No. - 29
Case :- Writ - C No. - 25761 of 2024
Petitioner :- Kuldeep
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Gopal Krishna,Vipul Singh Counsel for Respondent :- Dharmendra Dhar Dubey,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.
Heard Shri Vipul Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner; Shri Rajeev Gupta, learned Addl.

Chief Standing Counsel for State respondents and Shri Dharmendra Dhar Dubey, learned counsel for U.P.
State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC).
2.

The instant writ petition has been preferred for following reliefs:-
"(i) to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to pay the compensation to the petitioner of Plot No.453-ka, Area 0.101 Hectare situated at Village Babrala Pargana Asadpur, Tehsil Gunnaur, District Kuldeep vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67292059/
1 Sambhal within stipulated period as specified by this Hon'ble Court.

(ii) to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no.2 to 4 to dispose of the application dated 16.09.2023 (Annx. No.2)
applying the proceeding of the Land Acquisition Act 1894/ Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of the acquired land of the petitioner within stipulated period of three months."
3. On the matter being taken up on 23.8.2024, the Court had asked learned counsel for the respondents to take instructions in the matter.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Act 1894/ Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
In response to the said order, learned Addl. Chief Standing Counsel has placed the detailed instructions sent by the District Magistrate, Sambhal,
which is taken on record.

On the basis of instructions, he states that for the land in dispute counter and counter claim had been set up by the parties and the matter is seized before the Authority concerned under Section 31/32 of U.P. Revenue Code, 2006 (in short "Code") in which the next date fixed is 20.09.2024.
4.
Considering the factual situation, as the matter is seized before the Authority concerned under the Code, we are not inclined to entertain the instant writ petition at this stage.
Needless to say, the petitioner is at liberty to press the relief in the ongoing proceeding under the Code.

5. With the aforesaid leave, the instant writ petition stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 13.9.2024 SP/
